# Burning Springs: Map with all locations, regions & no-camp zones

The new Burning Springs region is located to the west next to the Ohio River. You can already find all locations on these maps and also look for new areas for a CAMP that are not in a “No Camp Zone”. Unfortunately, the map is not fully connected to the previous West and the Ohio and is only accessible on foot via the Point Pleasant Bridge. On the map with the marked regions you can clearly see the area in which you can actually move around in Burning Springs. In the game, however, this area appears larger than you would expect on the map. The game feeling there is really good and is very reminiscent of Fallout New Vegas. I'm curious how you will like the **Update on December 2nd, 2025**.
